recentItems.title: Lul Tim on Finding Out He Killed King Von:  If He Didn't Attack Quando He'd Be Alive (Flashback)
recentItems.description:
In this flashback, Lul Tim opened up about the intense night that led to the fatal shooting of fellow rapper King Von. Reflecting on the incident, Lul Tim expressed regret and suggested that if Von had not initiated the conflict, the tragedy might have been avoided.

While recounting the chaotic series of events, Lul Tim described being shot multiple times and undergoing surgery at the same hospital where King Von was treated. He also shared his surprise upon learning that Von had died, emphasizing that his actions were driven by a desire to protect his friend rather than malice.

To hear more, view the full interview above.

recentItems.title: Treach: If 2Pac's Alive, I'm Not Telling (Flashback)
recentItems.description:
In this flashback, Naughty by Nature frontman Treach sat down with VladTV and opened up about his close friendship with Tupac Shakur. Treach recalled how Tupac looked out for him while he was in Los Angeles, including a sit-down they had in Compton where they addressed and cleared up issues Treach had with certain individuals on the West Coast.

Tupac later compared the situation to his own experience of being shot in New York, saying he hoped Biggie would look out for him the same way he had looked out for Treach. Treach explained that while Tupac had the street connections and influence to help him in Los Angeles, Biggie didn't necessarily have the same type of street connections in New York to look out for Tupac in the way Shakur believed he could.

Check out the footage above.

recentItems.title: Did FBG Butta Predict Lil Durk Would Be Arrested for M*rder for Hire??🤔
Judge Mathis Predicts Keefe D Will Be Found Not Guilty (Part 1)
recentItems.description:
Become a VladStocks Member now: https://www.youtube.com/vladtv/join
--------
Judge Greg Mathis joins VladTV to break down the Keefe D trial in the 1996 Tupac Shakur murder case, explaining why he believes prosecutors have not met the “beyond a reasonable doubt” standard required in Nevada. Speaking as closing arguments head toward the jury, Mathis weighs the impact of Keefe D’s paid interviews, alleged boasts, and the lack of direct evidence placing him in Las Vegas at the time of the shooting. Vlad also reflects on his own interview being used in court, the Mike Tyson fight, Death Row Records, Orlando Anderson, Suge Knight conspiracy theories, and the long shadow of Black Panther-era surveillance involving Afeni Shakur and Malcolm X. Mathis clarifies the difference between civil and criminal burdens of proof, discusses a possible hung jury or mistrial, and predicts how plea negotiations could unfold if the state chooses to retry the case.

recentItems.title: Charleston White & Mob James Meet for First Time Since 2023 to Squash Beef
recentItems.description:
Watch the FULL uncensored interview early - become a VladTV YouTube Member now:
https://www.youtube.com/vladtv/join
--------
In a powerful reconciliation, Mob James and Charleston White sit down together to address their past conflict, a confrontation in Dallas that could have ended in violence, and the events that ultimately brought them face-to-face to make peace.
Charleston acknowledges Mob James' transformation from his violent past into a grandfather and community advocate, explaining why he wanted to move beyond their public feud. Mob James reveals that he drove from California to Texas specifically to meet Charleston, leading to an emotional conversation between the two men about their differences and the consequences their conflict could have created.
Both reflect on surviving difficult environments and evolving beyond the versions of themselves that once relied on anger, retaliation, and street politics. They discuss family, maturity, accountability, and how getting older changed their perspectives on what it truly means to be respected.
The conversation becomes deeply personal as Mob James and Charleston examine their own mistakes and explain why forgiveness doesn't require forgetting what happened. Instead of allowing pride to escalate their disagreement, both men acknowledge the importance of recognizing personal growth and giving people an opportunity to change.
What began as a potentially dangerous rivalry ultimately becomes a conversation about reconciliation, demonstrating how two men with very different backgrounds and personalities can put ego aside, confront their issues directly, and walk away with mutual understanding.

recentItems.title: Billy Garland, 2Pac's Biological Father, Tells His Life Story (Flashback)
recentItems.description:
In this flashback, Tupac Shakur's biological father, Billy Garland, detailed his life story in this VladTV exclusive. Garland reflected on his childhood experiences and the events that led him to join the Black Panther Party. He discussed his role in the political organization, as well as his relationship with fellow Black Panther Afeni Shakur.

After conceiving Tupac with Afeni, Garland's presence in his son's life was limited to Tupac's early years. He explained the circumstances that ultimately led to his estrangement from the future Hip-Hop legend. Later in the interview, Garland broke down the chain of events that led to him reconnecting with Tupac and how they began rebuilding their relationship.

Garland also offered a unique perspective on Tupac's life and opened up about the legal dispute he had with Afeni Shakur following Tupac's death. To hear more, view the full interview above.
